text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah! O-Ow-w-w...
What the heck, did I catch a cold or something...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, let's not push it and just
head home to rest, shall we—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, gather 'round!
It's picture-story show time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, if you kids wanna watch the picture show,
buy some cherry pie and cola first!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What is this, America?! Where on earth
do you find a picture-story teller feeding people pies?!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, now then—
"Ghost Story: Tulip Lantern Episode 7"
is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Is this some grand epic?! This isn't the kind of story you tell with paper theater! Put it in movie theaters already!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~ shoot, look at the time.
The story was full of ridiculous stuff, but the storytelling was so good I watched it all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ouch...
Ugh... I was plannin' on gettin' to bed early, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that,
Lucky Lilac was plagued by a headache.
